test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

× and ÷

I. 16 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 + 7

II. 8 ÷ 4 - 9 × 3 + 8
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given: × and ÷

I. 16 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 + 7

After interchanging the given two signs we get:

⇒ 16 × 4 - __**8 ÷ 2**__ + 7

⇒ __**16 × 4**__ - 4 + 7

⇒ __64__ - 4 __**+ 7**__

⇒ __**71 - 4**__ = **67**

II. 8 ÷ 4 - 9 × 3 + 8 

After interchanging the given two signs we get:

⇒ 8 × 4 - __**9 ÷ 3**__ + 8

⇒ __**8 × 4**__ - 3 + 8

⇒ __32__ - 3 __**+ 8**__

⇒ __**40 - 3**__ = 37

Hence, the correct answer is "**67 and 37**".
